build.linked_dependencies: Local GLFW 3.4 static library, opengl32, gdi32
build.scope: Clean compile and link from current C++ sources through the repository build script. GLSL is compiled at runtime, not by this build.

current_room_export_observed.asset_verification: Root reports verify_assets PASS for room and atrium; this agent did not repeat that suite.

completion_scope_review.basis: Read-only inspection of current input handlers, render loop, SceneSettings movement/collision code, asset loader and navigation test source, together with previously recorded passing results.

walking.behavior: WASD movement follows horizontal yaw, diagonal movement is normalized, Shift changes speed, frame dt is capped and collision movement is split into steps no longer than 0.08 m.
walking.scope: Ground-plane walking constrained to the authored room and atrium circulation; upper galleries and sky are not traversable.

looking.behavior: Left click captures GLFW cursor; mouse delta updates yaw and pitch, pitch is clamped near vertical, Esc releases and R resets camera.
looking.prior_evidence: room-walk-v6.log records mouse_orientation=PASS. This unit direction check is not an exhaustive hardware/manual input test.

collision.behavior: Three repeated projections handle discs, capsules, rectangular room bounds and radial atrium boundary.
collision.test_source_coverage: navigation_test.cpp exercises large door/wall moves, capsule sides/ends/diagonals, 360 approaches to the pond, every exported canal capsule from both sides and full outer circulation in both directions.
collision.prior_recorded_result: 69,000 movement checks PASS in the retained validation record. This build-only step did not rerun them.

scene_loading.behavior: Keys1/2 load configuration and mesh into temporary owners before replacement, upload material arrays and reset spawn/yaw/pitch. Invalid names, missing/malformed settings, invalid mesh headers, truncated mesh payloads or out-of-range transparent draw groups raise explicit errors.
scene_loading.prior_evidence: room-walk-v6.log records room/atrium/room, 720 frames, gl_error=0 with resize exercised by smoke mode.

assets.behavior: The binary resolves the dream root from its executable location or --root, loads .scene/.dreammesh/.draws plus bitmap textures, and compiles shader files on startup. A restart is required for edited geometry, maps or shaders.
assets.scope: Successful C++ linking alone does not prove the new final probe or mesh renders correctly.

resizing.behavior: Each frame reads framebuffer size and resizes opaque/composite/MSAA/reflection targets; minimized zero-size frames wait.
resizing.prior_evidence: The v6 smoke path resized640x480 then1280x720 with collected GL error0. No fresh v7 render run was performed in this build-only step.
